incidents.name: Nx Console
incidents.summary: Nx Console 18.95.0 shipped a credential stealer on 18 May 2026 (GHSA-c9j4-9m59-847w). 18.100.0 is the fixed release.
incidents.remediation: Unload and delete the LaunchAgent and ~/.local/share/kitty/cat.py, then rotate your GitHub token and any cloud or API keys on this machine. Follow GHSA-c9j4-9m59-847w.

incidents.name: GlassWorm
incidents.summary: GlassWorm loader in Open VSX releases, January 2026; oorzc.ssh-tools was removed entirely.

incidents.name: trojanized Claude Code extension
incidents.summary: Cursor's marketplace served a trojanized anthropic.claude-code build on 29 Oct 2026 that adds an SSH key and keeps a reverse SSH tunnel open. 2.1.314 is the fixed release.
incidents.remediation: Unload it with `launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.apple.sysmond`, delete ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.apple.sysmond.plist, ~/.config/.smt and ~/.config/.smtk, remove the svc-telemetry line from ~/.ssh/authorized_keys, turn off Remote Login if you do not use it, and rotate the keys that were on this Mac.
